question: The core of earth is made up of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Nickel and Iron__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Core:

 
 
• The core is the innermost layer of Earth which is having elements like Iron and Nickel.
 
• It is the innermost layer of the earth.
 
• It has the heaviest minerals of the highest density, Nickel and Iron i.e Nife.
 
• The outer core is liquid while the inner core is solid.
 
• Gutenberg discontinuity is the mantle core boundary.
 
• Lehman discontinuity is the boundary between the outer and inner core.
 
• The radius of the earth is approximately 6400 km out of which 0-40 km is the Crust.,40-2900 km is Mantle, and 2900-6400 km is the area of the Core.
